verdict.rationale: Sardine is a fraud-prevention and compliance SaaS that collects identity, device and transaction data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion APIs, or data-erasure controls. The cited items cover KYB/KYC, device signals, screening and case management, none of which concern this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
